q: McCann's displacement interpolation (1997) shows that the geodesic in (P(M), W₂) between μ₀ and μ₁ is given by:
opts: μ_t = ((1-t)id + tT)_*μ₀ where T is the optimal transport map (push-forward along the straight-line map)
μ_t = T^t_*μ₀ for the flow T^t
exp: Displacement interpolation: μ_t = ((1-t)x + tT(x))_*μ₀ where T = ∇φ is the optimal transport map. The path t ↦ μ_t is the unique constant-speed geodesic in (P(M),W₂). This is fundamentally different from the linear interpolation μ_t = (1-t)μ₀+tμ₁ (which is the mixture, not a geodesic).
